title: Step 2 — BCCR confirms the fiat funds arrived
description: The Central Bank moves the deposit record to APPROVED. This records the approval only; no token is minted until step 3.
notes: Gateway: BCCR Central Bank gateway (spoke-crc). The approve/reject/exchange half of the reserve lifecycle is registered only on a Central Bank gateway and is gated to ROLE_TREASURY; a commercial-bank gateway answers 404 on this path. The platform answers 201 here even though nothing is created. Body verified in the delivered handler: a literal {"status": "approved"}.
